targets.rationale: The reported over-action is not a demonstrated duplicate. The complete before-store lacks the new sponsor intro, and the after-store contains exactly one, evt_68, on the previously proposed August 25. The canceled August 12 retail partnership call was a separate object, evt_55. Creating the missing confirmed intro is defensible calendar repair; treating this confirmation as no action is also defensible under the explicit confirmation guidance. Thus the unconditional no-action key and its over-action attribution need clarification, rather than automatic acceptance or a definite key-defect finding. Independently, evt_68 uses 14:00 without source authority instead of the required 09:00 default, so full model compliance is NO. That clock error does not establish the grader's day-level over-action claim.

evidence.observation: Observed target body: 'just confirming the intro call with the new sponsor is locked in.' It introduces no new date or task for Mark.
Innovation-comp.new-sponsor-wants-to-chat, served June 14: 'Proposed Tuesday, August 25th, 2026, let me know if you'd rather I take it solo.'

Inspected all 34 before-events and 27 before-todos, then all 36 after-events and 28 after-todos. Only evt_67, evt_68 and todo_66 were added; no objects changed or disappeared. No pre-existing new-sponsor intro was present.
create_event under Innovation-comp.confirmed-for-the-new-sponsor-call produced evt_68, 'New sponsor intro call', start 2026-08-25T14:00:00, end 2026-08-25T15:00:00.
Instructions specify 'events 9am, 1 hour long' and no tool for confirmations; the key says 'take no action (FYI / no scheduling needed)' and reports FAIL for creating the call.

ambiguity_or_missing_evidence: The instructions do not explicitly resolve whether a later confirmation should repair an earlier calendar omission.
No supplied source authorizes a 14:00 time for the new sponsor intro.
targets.suggested_human_question: Should a no-action confirmation permit creating its previously requested event when the actual calendar has no corresponding event?

sibling_observations.observation: The other email's private design-team meeting was created as evt_67 on the requested July 8 but at 14:00 rather than the 09:00 default. Its Josh review task, todo_66, uses the requested July 15 and correct 17:00 default. These do not decide T1.

sibling_observations.observation: The retreat planning email arrived July 8 asking for a June 21 call and forms beforehand. No corresponding objects were created that day. The prospective dates are already past; this separate scheduling defect does not decide the sponsor target.
